verdicts.reason: A squeezes 'Every mixed case.' into a cramped three-line stack beside the CTA, which makes the bottom band crowded, and pushes the legal line into a tiny cramped caption under the button. The shoe also sits awkwardly off-centre against the big empty circle, leaving dead space in the middle. B keeps a clean headline/subcopy/product/CTA sequence with a large, well-scaled shoe, but it moves the 'WEEKEND ONLY' kicker below the subcopy (wrong reading order), mixes a left-aligned text column with a centred CTA, leaves a loose gap above the button, and its legal text is tiny.
